text:
Nora (CSM): HorizonHealth asked for a compact enablement day next Wed to prep for their Dedicated trial and renewal review. They want a morning infra workshop, an afternoon PM demo, and a short late-afternoon office hours window. Can we staff and confirm prereqs?

Ish (CS Ops): I can run invites and timezone mapping. Which timezone are they in?

Priya (HorizonHealth): Most of the team is CST; a couple in GMT. Morning CST is best (which is early afternoon GMT). Proposed: Wed 09:30-11:30 CST workshop, 13:00-13:45 CST PM demo, 16:00-16:45 CST office hours.

Camila (Trainer): I can lead the workshop. Request: prework checklist (10m video), sandbox accounts per pair, and a short security slide.

Dev (Eng): I can provision a sandbox with preloaded "horizon-sample-v3" and pin model `gptx-3.7-ded`. No SSH; web containers only. ETA Tue EOD for provisioning.

Nora (CSM): Headcounts: workshop = 6 infra, PM demo = 5, office hours = 3-5. Add a 20m perf reading + cost breakout to the workshop.

Camila (Trainer): Draft agenda: intro (10m), infra deep-dive (20m), paired lab (60m), perf & security (20m), wrap (10m). Will add KMS notes.

Ish (CS Ops): I'll send tentative invites now and flip to confirmed once Dev marks the sandbox ready. Short subject: "HorizonHealth: Dedicated prep & enablement (Wed)". Recording enabled.

calendar-bot: Event created: "HorizonHealth: Dedicated prep workshop" Wed 09:30-11:30 CST guests: 6 (tentative). Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/horizonprep

Dev (Eng): Sandbox provisioned. Temp creds DM'd to Priya. Endpoint: https://sandbox.horizon.redwood; token template horizon_user_{n}.

Priya (HorizonHealth): Got creds and shared with team. Please include the recording for the PMs who are GMT.

Nora (CSM): I'll prepare a post-session playbook and capture baseline latency + median token cost for renewal materials.

Ish (CS Ops): Invites updated to "confirmed". Thanks team, see you Wed.

Priya (HorizonHealth): Thanks everyone! Looking forward.
